metadata.selection_rationale: Prioritizes verified healthcare services, Python APIs, AWS/cloud integration, data quality, backend reliability, testing, and stakeholder delivery without claiming Go, Postgres production ownership, patient-monitoring ownership, clinical work, or startup-scale production traffic.
